+    def _combine_fast_deletes(self, fast_deletes):
+        """
+        Combine a list of fast-delete querysets for the same model into a
+        single queryset when it is safe to do so.
+        """
+        if len(fast_deletes) == 1:
+            return fast_deletes[0]
+        if not hasattr(fast_deletes[0], '_clone'):
+            return None
+        model = fast_deletes[0].model
+        base_alias = model._meta.db_table
+        combined_where = None
+        for qs in fast_deletes:
+            if qs.model is not model or not hasattr(qs, 'query'):
+                return None
+            query = qs.query
+            query.get_initial_alias()
+            used_tables = [alias for alias in query.alias_map if query.alias_refcount[alias]]
+            if used_tables != [base_alias]:
+                return None
+            if combined_where is None:
+                combined_where = query.where.clone()
+            else:
+                combined_where.add(query.where.clone(), 'OR')
+        if combined_where is None:
+            return None
+        combined_qs = fast_deletes[0]._clone()
+        combined_qs.query.get_initial_alias()
+        combined_qs.query.where = combined_where
+        # Don't combine queries when doing so would exceed the backend's
+        # maximum number of query parameters.
+        max_query_params = connections[self.using].features.max_query_params
+        if max_query_params:
+            compiler = combined_qs.query.get_compiler(self.using)
+            try:
+                _, params = compiler.compile(combined_where)
+            except EmptyResultSet:
+                return None
+            if len(params) > max_query_params:
+                return None
+        return combined_qs
+
